definitions.explanation: A mesh or net-style shelf above seats on trains and buses for storing bags and luggage during travel.

examples.japanese: ⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{網棚|あみだな}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{載|の}せる→載せる：28290_noseru⟧。
examples.english: Put the luggage on the overhead rack.

examples.japanese: {網棚|あみだな}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{傘|かさ}→傘：00639_kasa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{忘|わす}れた→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧。
examples.english: I forgot my umbrella on the luggage rack.

examples.japanese: ⟦{降|お}りる→降りる：00568_oriru⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{網棚|あみだな}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}して→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please check for your belongings on the overhead rack before getting off.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{網|あみ}→網：22587_ami⟧ (net, mesh) + ⟦{棚|たな}→棚：01650_tana⟧ (shelf)

USAGE:
Traditionally made of rope or metal mesh, hence the name. Modern trains may have solid shelves, but the term {網棚|あみだな} is still commonly used.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {網棚|あみだな}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{載|の}せる→載せる：28290_noseru⟧ (to put on the rack)
- {網棚|あみだな}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{下|お}ろす→下ろす：02029_orosu⟧ (to take down from the rack)
- {網棚|あみだな}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{忘|わす}れ{物|もの}→忘れ物：01758_wasuremono⟧ (forgotten items on the rack)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{忘|わす}れ{物|もの}→忘れ物：01758_wasuremono⟧: lost item, forgotten item
- ⟦{手荷物|てにもつ}→手荷物：09928_tenimotsu⟧: hand luggage
